cues.en: I will talk more about this in the next video, but briefly, this is pretty typical.
cues.zh: 下一部影片會再談，但簡單說，這相當典型。

cues.en: You want to spend, you know, as a data scientist or a data explorer, you want to be spending a lot of time characterizing
cues.zh: 作為資料科學家或資料探索者，應該花許多時間描述

cues.en: and understanding your data before getting to the, you know, worrying about p-values and things like that.
cues.zh: 與理解資料，之後再去關心 P 值之類的事情。

cues.en: Okay, so we're gonna do a couple of analyses here.
cues.zh: 這裡要做幾項分析。

cues.en: The first one is that we are going to correlate the marriage rates and the divorce rates over time per state.
cues.zh: 第一項，是在各州內，計算結婚率與離婚率隨時間的相關。

cues.en: So what we saw in the previous few videos is that marriage rates are declining over time and divorce rates are declining over time.
cues.zh: 前幾部影片中，我們看到結婚率隨時間下降，離婚率也隨時間下降。

cues.en: And the question I want to ask here is, whether those declines within each state are correlated over the 30-year period.
cues.zh: 這裡想問的是，各州內的這兩種下降，在 30 年間是否相關。

cues.en: Okay, so here's what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 以下是做法。

cues.en: We're going to loop over states, and within each state, we are going to compute the correlation.
cues.zh: 用迴圈走過各州，在每個州內計算相關。

cues.en: So the Pearson correlation between the marriage data and the divorce data.
cues.zh: 也就是結婚資料與離婚資料之間的皮爾森相關。

cues.en: Plot that as a point on a graph, and then color that point according to whether the p-value is less than the p-value threshold.
cues.zh: 把它畫成圖上的一個點，再根據 P 值是否低於門檻來設定點的顏色。

cues.en: Now, I'm setting the threshold here to be 0.05 divided by 51.
cues.zh: 這裡把門檻設成 0.05 除以 51。

cues.en: This is Bonferroni corrected for 50 states, plus Washington DC.
cues.zh: 這是對 50 州加上華盛頓特區，做 Bonferroni 校正。

cues.en: So this corrected p-value threshold is actually a little bit conservative, and it's conservative because Bonferroni correction assumes
cues.zh: 這個校正後的 P 值門檻其實有點保守，因為 Bonferroni 校正假設

cues.en: that all of your tests are independent, that they're all statistically independent of each other.
cues.zh: 所有檢定都獨立，在統計上彼此獨立。

cues.en: But that's obviously not the case here.
cues.zh: 但這裡顯然不是如此。

cues.en: So for example, you know, Pennsylvania and New York, those are neighboring states.
cues.zh: 例如，賓夕法尼亞與紐約是相鄰的州。

cues.en: They're very similar to each other culturally and socioeconomically.
cues.zh: 它們在文化與社會經濟上非常相似。

cues.en: So it's not reasonable to expect that the marriage and divorce rates in Pennsylvania are gonna be totally independent of the marriage and divorce rates in New York.
cues.zh: 因此，不能合理地預期，賓夕法尼亞的結婚率與離婚率，會完全獨立於紐約的結婚率與離婚率。

cues.en: Nonetheless, Bonferroni correction gives us a conservative threshold.
cues.zh: 不過，Bonferroni 校正提供一個保守的門檻。

cues.en: And when doing statistical thresholding, it's better to be a little bit conservative than a little bit too liberal.
cues.zh: 進行統計門檻判斷時，稍微保守一點，比稍微過度寬鬆好。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: So I think I'll just run this code, and we can inspect this all.
cues.zh: 我直接執行這段程式，再一起檢查。

cues.en: Now, it doesn't all fit on, you know, it doesn't all fit on one page, but that's because I'm zoomed in a little bit for the video.
cues.zh: 畫面無法全部放在同一頁，因為為了錄影，我把畫面稍微放大。

cues.en: Okay, so here, we see the correlation coefficient on the X axis, spanning from -1 to +1, and the Y axis is the state.
cues.zh: 這裡 X 軸是相關係數，從 −1 到 +1，Y 軸是州。

cues.en: So we have all the states here listed alphabetically, and the dot here, the marker indicates the correlation between marriage and divorce.
cues.zh: 所有州按字母排列，而這裡的點、標記，代表結婚與離婚之間的相關。

cues.en: Now, you would probably intuitively expect that the marriage and divorce rates would be strongly and significantly correlated.
cues.zh: 直覺上，你可能預期結婚率與離婚率會高度且顯著相關。

cues.en: That makes sense to me anyway when you have more people getting married, then you're also gonna have more people getting divorced.
cues.zh: 這對我來說很合理，因為結婚的人越多，離婚的人也會越多。

cues.en: And conversely or complimentary, when you have fewer people getting married, you're gonna have fewer people getting divorced.
cues.zh: 反過來，或互補地說，結婚的人越少，離婚的人也會越少。

cues.en: So strong, positive, significant correlations seem to be sensible, but we can see that there's also quite a few states where the correlation coefficients are positive.
cues.zh: 所以，強烈、正向、顯著的相關看起來合理；但可以看到，也有不少州的相關係數雖然是正的，

cues.en: They are, you know, sort of modest, least size, but they're not statistically significant.
cues.zh: 大小大約中等，卻沒有統計顯著性。

cues.en: And we have some other states where the correlation is just zero.
cues.zh: 另一些州的相關則是零。

cues.en: So that's pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 這很有意思。

cues.en: So in Montana and Minnesota, there's basically no correlation between marriage and divorce rates over time.
cues.zh: 在蒙大拿與明尼蘇達，結婚率與離婚率隨時間基本上沒有相關。

cues.en: Now, you know, like I've said before, I don't really know how to interpret this result.
cues.zh: 就像先前說的，我其實不知道如何解讀這個結果。

cues.en: I'm not an expert on, you know, family planning in Montana and Minnesota, but it's pretty interesting that these are strikingly different
cues.zh: 我不是蒙大拿與明尼蘇達家庭規劃方面的專家，但它們和其他所有州

cues.en: from all the other states.
cues.zh: 明顯不同，這很有意思。

cues.en: Now, out of curiosity, I wonder how many of these states, how many of these correlations actually would be statistically significant if we would drop the Bonferroni correction threshold.
cues.zh: 出於好奇，我想知道，如果移除 Bonferroni 校正門檻，有多少州、有多少相關會具有統計顯著性。

cues.en: So I'm going to comment out the Bonferroni and set the p-value threshold to be just regular 0.05.
cues.zh: 所以我把 Bonferroni 註解掉，把 P 值門檻設成一般的 0.05。

cues.en: So this means we are not correcting for multiple comparisons across states.
cues.zh: 這表示沒有針對跨州的多重比較做校正。

cues.en: I'm doing this out of curiosity to see which states still have a non-significant correlation even without correcting for multiple comparisons.
cues.zh: 我只是好奇，即使不做多重比較校正，哪些州的相關仍然不顯著。

cues.en: And now, it just drops to a few.
cues.zh: 現在只剩下幾個。

cues.en: You remember there were several more of these green dots that were previously red.
cues.zh: 記得，這裡多了幾個綠點，先前都是紅的。

cues.en: Okay, so that was one analysis that I was curious about.
cues.zh: 這是我好奇的一項分析。

cues.en: There's a second analysis, which is whether the marriage and divorce rates really changed over time, whether they really decreased.
cues.zh: 還有第二項分析：結婚率與離婚率是否真的隨時間改變，是否真的下降。

cues.en: Now, I'm gonna scroll all the way back up here to some of the plots we created in previous videos.
cues.zh: 現在一路往上捲，回到先前影片中建立的一些圖。

cues.en: So here, you see the marriage rates over time.
cues.zh: 這裡看到結婚率隨時間的變化。

cues.en: Now, it's not so, you know, obvious that the rates are declining, right?
cues.zh: 這些比率是否下降，其實不太明顯，對吧？

cues.en: You do see that they're declining here, but it's actually possible that some of these states are not declining.
cues.zh: 這裡確實看到下降，但有些州也可能沒有下降。

cues.en: Maybe they're even increasing a little bit.
cues.zh: 甚至可能稍微上升。

cues.en: So I wanted to know, you know, is this observation that the marriage rates are declining over time?
cues.zh: 所以我想知道，結婚率隨時間下降的觀察，

cues.en: Is that a real thing or is that just me over-interpreting what I think I see or maybe what I want to see on this graph?
cues.zh: 是真實情況，還是我過度解讀了自己以為看到的，或者想在圖上看到的事情？

cues.en: So that's why we're doing statistics all the way down here.
cues.zh: 這就是我們在下面做統計的原因。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: So we are looping over all the states, so all the rows in the data matrix.
cues.zh: 用迴圈走過所有州，也就是資料矩陣的所有列。

cues.en: And for each state, I'm doing a regression.
cues.zh: 對每個州做一次迴歸。

cues.en: I'm running a linear regression of the year on the marriage rates, and of course, also on the divorce rates.
cues.zh: 用年份對結婚率做線性迴歸，當然，也對離婚率做。

cues.en: So that gives me the slope, the beta coefficients, which I'm then normalizing all this stuff I've discussed in the section on regression.
cues.zh: 這會得到斜率，也就是 β 係數，再進行正規化；這些都在迴歸章節討論過。

cues.en: And what we're really interested in here is the slopes, then I'm plotting the slopes, and then I wanna do another test of whether the slopes are different
cues.zh: 真正感興趣的是斜率；接著畫出斜率，再做另一個檢定，看看各州內

cues.en: between marriages and divorces within each state.
cues.zh: 結婚與離婚的斜率是否不同。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm just gonna run all this code, and then we can look at the graph, and then I will explain more of what this code is doing after we interpret the graph.
cues.zh: 我先執行所有程式，看看圖，解讀之後，再多解釋程式在做什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so here, we see all of the states on the X axis, and the Y axis shows the decrease per year.
cues.zh: 這裡 X 軸是所有州，Y 軸顯示每年的下降程度。

cues.en: This is normalized, so these are normalized beta coefficient, so we don't need to interpret these in any particular way, but the sign, of course, is important.
cues.zh: 這些已經正規化，是正規化後的 β 係數，所以不必用什麼特定方式解讀，但符號當然很重要。

cues.en: So we see that the sign almost everywhere is negative, meaning that it really is the case that the marriage rates and the divorce rates are decreasing
cues.zh: 可以看到，幾乎每個地方的符號都是負的，表示結婚率與離婚率確實

cues.en: over time.
cues.zh: 正在隨時間下降。

cues.en: The marriages are shown in the circles and the divorce rates are shown in the squares.
cues.zh: 圓圈是結婚率，方形是離婚率。

cues.en: So again, the Y axis here corresponds to the slope or the rates of decrease of marriages and divorce rates over time in all of these different states.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡 Y 軸對應所有不同州的結婚率與離婚率隨時間變化的斜率，或下降速率。

cues.en: So by and large, nearly all of them are negative and also significantly negative.
cues.zh: 整體而言，幾乎全部為負，而且顯著為負。

cues.en: There's a couple of non-significant values here, and there's even one value in DC where the marriage rate actually increased over time.
cues.zh: 有幾個不顯著的值，甚至特區有一個值，結婚率其實隨時間上升。

cues.en: It's a small effect size, it didn't increase a lot, but it was a significant increase in the marriage rate over a 30-year period in Washington dc.
cues.zh: 效果量很小，增加不多，但華盛頓特區在 30 年間的結婚率確實顯著上升。

cues.en: So this made me wonder one more thing, and this brings us to the last analysis that I ran here.
cues.zh: 這讓我又好奇一件事，也就是最後做的那項分析。

cues.en: And I was wondering whether the rate of decline in marriages and divorces are the same.
cues.zh: 我想知道，結婚率與離婚率的下降速率是否相同。

cues.en: In other words, fewer people are getting married and fewer people are getting divorced, but is it the case that there's an equal number of people getting married and divorced over time?
cues.zh: 換句話說，結婚的人變少，離婚的人也變少，但隨著時間，結婚與離婚的人數是否相等？

cues.en: Or is the rate of marriage different from the rate of the decline of divorces?
cues.zh: 還是結婚的速率，與離婚的下降速率不同？

cues.en: So what I did was subtract the two slopes, the two beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 因此，我把兩個斜率、兩個 β 係數相減。

cues.en: So the change in marriage over time minus the change in divorce over time.
cues.zh: 也就是結婚隨時間的變化，減去離婚隨時間的變化。

cues.en: And that gives us this plot with one date of value per state.
cues.zh: 這樣得到這張圖，每個州一個資料值。

cues.en: So how do we interpret this?
cues.zh: 要如何解讀？

cues.en: Well, remember that the marriages and divorces are both decreasing over time in basically all of the states.
cues.zh: 記得，基本上所有州的結婚率與離婚率都隨時間下降。

cues.en: The question is whether the marriages or the divorces are decreasing faster.
cues.zh: 問題是，結婚還是離婚下降得比較快。

cues.en: So any state that has a positive value, so a positive slope difference here, means that the divorce rate is declining faster.
cues.zh: 如果某個州的值為正，也就是這裡的斜率差為正，表示離婚率下降得比較快。

cues.en: So that means that in California, over a 30-year period, fewer people are getting married, but the people who are getting married
cues.zh: 這表示，在加州這 30 年間，結婚的人變少，但結婚的人

cues.en: are even less likely to get divorced.
cues.zh: 更不容易離婚。

cues.en: So the marriage rates are declining, but the divorce rates are declining even faster.
cues.zh: 因此，結婚率在下降，但離婚率下降得更快。

cues.en: Now, it's not so visually obvious that this is going to be significantly positive or significantly negative.
cues.zh: 從視覺上不太明顯，這會是顯著正值，還是顯著負值。

cues.en: Unlike here, you know, here, it's totally obvious that the slopes are negative almost everywhere.
cues.zh: 不像這裡，幾乎處處的斜率都是負的，這非常明顯。

cues.en: So I ran a T-test here.
cues.zh: 所以我在這裡做 t 檢定。

cues.en: Let me see, let me go back and show you some of this code.
cues.zh: 讓我回去展示一部分程式。

cues.en: So here, we have the normalized beta coefficients, and then here, I'm storing for each row in the data matrix, which means each state, I'm storing the difference between the beta,
cues.zh: 這裡是正規化後的 β 係數，接著對資料矩陣的每一列，也就是每個州，儲存 β 的差，

cues.en: so the slope for marriage minus the slope for the divorce.
cues.zh: 也就是結婚斜率減去離婚斜率。

cues.en: And then we have this vector of the slope differences.
cues.zh: 接著得到這個斜率差向量。

cues.en: And then I run a one sample T-test on those data against zero.
cues.zh: 再對這些資料做單一樣本 t 檢定，與零比較。

cues.en: And then I put the result of the t-test, so the degrees of freedom, the t-value, and the p-value into the title of this lower graph here.
cues.zh: 然後把 t 檢定的結果，也就是自由度、t 值與 P 值，放在下面這張圖的標題。

cues.en: Okay, so we see that this T statistic is significant.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個 t 統計量是顯著的。

cues.en: The p-value is 0.04, around.
cues.zh: P 值大約是 0.04。

cues.en: Now, this is not a huge effect size.
cues.zh: 這不是很大的效果量。

cues.en: So the T value is 2.1.
cues.zh: t 值是 2.1。

cues.en: It is statistically significant with 50 degrees of freedom, but this isn't really a huge effect size.
cues.zh: 在 50 個自由度下，具有統計顯著性，但效果量並不真的很大。

cues.en: So it is the case statistically that over the past 30 years, fewer people are getting married but even fewer people are getting divorced.
cues.zh: 因此，統計上確實可以說，過去 30 年結婚的人變少，但離婚的人減少得更多。

cues.en: But that is not a huge effect size, and it's also not really the case in every state, like in Iowa, for example, it's not the case.
cues.zh: 不過，效果量不大，也不是每個州都如此，例如愛荷華州就不是。

cues.en: Okay, so that wraps that up.
cues.zh: 這部分就到這裡。

cues.en: These are the two main sets of statistical analyses that I performed on these data.
cues.zh: 這就是我對這些資料做的兩大類統計分析。

cues.en: So we have these analyses here, whether the correlations were significant between marriages and divorces within each state over time, and whether these slopes were significant
cues.zh: 這裡分析了，各州內結婚與離婚跨時間的相關是否顯著，以及斜率是否顯著，

cues.en: and significantly different between marriages and divorces.
cues.zh: 還有結婚與離婚的斜率是否顯著不同。
